concept: S3 Event Notifications → Lambda: serverless upload processing
tests: Choosing an event-driven serverless solution that reacts immediately when a file lands in S3, with no idle cost.
expected: An S3 event notification (s3:ObjectCreated) invokes Lambda — instant, pay only for execution. Triggers: "sporadic uploads", "start immediately when a file lands in S3", "fully serverless", "no idle cost", "thumbnails".
why_not: Cron on EC2 and ECS with polling run constantly and cost money while idle; a scheduled ASG action — time-based, not event-based.
